gen-gf-unkempt-manrope: Unkempt arrives loud and expressive, its t built with crossbar and stem in matching weight. But Manrope's bright, open curves give the page its best trait, a clear mouth on every round letter.
gen-gf-unkempt-satoshi: A soaring x-height gives Satoshi a bright, unsqueezed read, every stroke cut uniform. Satoshi stays approachable while Unkempt does the commanding, its gaps keeping c from turning into o.
gen-gf-unkempt-work-sans: Loud meets level-headed: Unkempt's crossbar and stem match in weight, while Work Sans keeps its c tips apart. Unkempt does the shouting; Work Sans keeps a high mean line in order.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-aldrich: Hard-edged boldness, with paper peeking through between the letters. Wallpoet commands the top, and Aldrich follows with a single thick thread of round, cupped letters and a high x-height.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada stands tall and squared-off, like woodblock lettering with terminals held far from the stem. But Wallpoet does the loud, show-stopping part, with paper showing between its letters.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Loud and see-through, Wallpoet leads, with Atkinson Hyperlegible Next tucked quietly underneath it. And in running text, those washer-wide eyes and open hooks keep the lines moving along smoothly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-biryani: Loud, see-through lettering sits over friendly, uniform-stroke text. Wallpoet earns its keep when it is big and brief, while Biryani's large-eyed e and unclogged small counters stay clear throughout.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-blinker: Commanding Wallpoet leads, its letters letting paper show through. Blinker holds its line thickness and open apertures, so a generous size lets that lowercase fill most of its height.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-chivo: Wallpoet comes in loud, with paper showing between letters. Chivo then settles comfortably into text, with lowercase packed up near the caps and bright daylight showing in every curve.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-chocolate-classical-s: Wallpoet hits hard and loud, with paper showing through between its letters. Chocolate Classical Sans has a sizable lowercase and broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut, so a modest size will do.
